audited_source_corrections.action: Localized the bare English cases entry 'otherwise' as Tamil text inside the display.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The second characteristic-function case leaves the ordinary English word 'otherwise' unwrapped in math mode, while the Tamil edition must translate formula annotations and must use a text wrapper for Tamil shaping.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாய்பாடு இரண்டாம் நேர்வை \text{இல்லையெனில்} என்று அமைத்து, பொருளையும் தமிழ் எழுத்துரு வடிவமைப்பையும் பாதுகாக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving one English prose word untranslated; placing raw Tamil letters in math mode.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The text wrapper is required for correct script shaping, and removing text bodies during formal-skeleton comparison leaves the intended zero branch unchanged.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the cases display now read naturally in Tamil while retaining the exact 1/0 conditions?

audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The exercise tells the reader to use the proofs of proposition rep2 and proposition rep2, although the immediately preceding paired existence and uniqueness propositions are rep1 and rep2.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பயிற்சி இருப்பையும் தனித்தன்மையையும் நிறுவும் prop:rep1, prop:rep2 ஆகிய இரு காட்டல்களையும் வழிகாட்டிகளாகச் சுட்டுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the duplicate reference; changing the second reference instead and listing the pair in reverse order.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The phrase 'proofs ... and ...' and the two immediately preceding propositions uniquely identify the intended pair and their natural order.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the exercise now direct the reader to both the existence and uniqueness proofs exactly once?
